battle-of-ankara-timur-bayezid.description: A bearded man in a white turban and a torn red-and-gold robe walks forward on a dusty battlefield, flanked by armoured soldiers in mail and helmets. On the right, an elderly bearded man in a white turban sits on a cushioned seat inside a large ornate tent, holding a staff. Behind them stand a grey war elephant with a howdah, a mounted rider on a dark horse, smoke and debris scattered on the ground. No visible text, no frame, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.

bayezid-welcomes-sephardic-jews.description: Dusk or night on a stone quay by dark water. On the left, a wooden ship's gangplank with a woman holding a torch; a group of people in dark cloaks and period dress come down it, including an elderly bearded man with a cane, a woman in a white headscarf, and a woman in a black shawl holding a baby. On the right, a man in a white turban and maroon fur-trimmed robe holds out one open hand in welcome, with a lantern-carrying guard beside him. Behind the water, sailing ships and a silhouette of a city with domes and minarets under a stormy sky. No visible text, no frame, nothing graphic.

selim-i-conquers-egypt-mamluks.description: An armoured rider in a white turban and dark robe sits on a dark bay horse at the centre, with a fortified gateway and minarets behind him. Men in white tall hats with long muskets march in the foreground, and smoke and fire fill the sky. Oil-painting style, no visible letters or frame.

battle-of-mohacs-ottoman-hungary.description: A heavily armoured knight on a dark horse charges left to right across a muddy, smoke-filled field. On the right, a row of musketeers in tall white felt hats fire long guns, and a large bronze cannon in the foreground belches flame. Other cannon and riders are dim in the smoke, with fire glowing in the background. Broken wood and a fallen helmet lie in the mud at lower left, and chain links trail across the ground. The painting fills the whole frame with no border, and there is no visible text.

treaty-of-karlowitz-ottoman.description: A painted interior of a dark wooden round room with a lit candle. Two men sit across a round wooden table. The man on the left wears a grey wrapped turban, a beard and a dark robe with thick fur trim. The man on the right has long dark curled hair, a white lace cravat and a dark coat with gold braid. He holds a quill over two sheets of paper with red wax seals. An inkwell sits on the table. No visible text, and the painting runs to the edges with no frame.

ibrahim-muteferrika-first-printed-book.description: A bearded man in a dark robe and wrapped turban strains on a long wooden lever of a screw press in a dim, lamplit workshop. Printed sheets hang on a cord overhead, marked with tiny illegible script-like lines; ink pots and paper stacks sit on tables. Warm dark oil painting that fills the image edge to edge, with no frame, signature or readable words.

treaty-of-kucuk-kaynarca.description: A night scene in a military camp. A man in a tricorn hat and dark green coat with red facings stands at left, holding a folded paper. A turbaned man in an embroidered robe leans in to take it, lit by a lantern. Behind them are soldiers in red coats with muskets, a cannon, and distant fires under a smoky sky. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.

janissaries-abolished-auspicious-inciden.description: A large copper cauldron lies on its side on cobblestones, with embers, ash, ladles, a wooden-handled blade and a gold-trimmed felt cap scattered around it. Behind is smoke and fire, a domed mosque with minarets, and on the right two wheeled cannons with silhouetted figures in red fezzes. No bodies are visible. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with a faint mark in the lower right corner that is not readable text.

tanzimat-reforms-gulhane-edict.description: A man in a black frock coat and red fez holds up an unrolled blank scroll in a garden of roses, with a crowd behind him: men in red fezzes, a bearded man in a white turban and brown robe, and a uniformed officer with gold epaulettes and a plumed bicorne on the right. Behind them are crenellated stone walls, bare trees and a stormy grey sky. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

ottoman-constitution-midhat-pasha.description: An oil-style painting of an elderly white-bearded man in a red fez and dark frock coat bending forward to hand a folded document to a bearded man seated in a gold-framed red velvet throne. The seated man wears a dark military-style uniform with gold epaulettes and a red fez. Behind them, a crowd of men in fezzes and dark suits stands in a candlelit hall with gilded columns, a crystal chandelier, heavy drapes and framed paintings. The image fills the full area edge to edge, with a small green mark in the bottom-right corner and no readable text.

ottomans-enter-first-world-war.description: A dark oil-painting style scene of a large grey battleship with two funnels and a crescent-and-star flag on its mast, firing its guns amid fireballs and black smoke over a choppy sea at dusk. Behind it, a harbour town on a hillside is burning, with smoke rising from the quayside and small white buildings and a minaret-like tower visible. Small figures stand on the deck, and splashes from near-miss shells dot the water. No text or frame is visible, and the painting fills the whole image.

armistice-of-mudros.description: A painted interior of a ship cabin with round portholes, through which grey warships sit on calm water. Several men in dark military uniforms and red fezzes stand around a wooden table, where a man in a dark uniform with red collar tabs leans forward to sign papers. An older officer in a navy peaked cap and double-breasted coat with gold sleeve stripes stands at the right, and a map, an inkwell, a pen and a small brass item lie on the table. The scene is lit by a warm lamp, and there is a small mark in the bottom-right corner.

ottoman-sultanate-abolished.description: An elderly man in a dark heavy overcoat and a red fez walks alone, leaning on a cane, up a wooden gangway toward a grey steel warship at dusk. Officers in dark uniforms stand at the rail under a lantern. Behind him across dark choppy water, a skyline of domes and slender minarets rises under a stormy sky. A small mark sits in the bottom-right corner.
